$schema_note: 7-day menu as designed. Meal times come from plan.json schedule and are editable in Settings. fresh (perishables per day) is reconciled with groceries.json ids.

macros_daily_estimate.note: Whole-menu estimates, not lab values. See RESEARCH.md on the protein flag.

cut_accelerators.rule: Bedtime milk + oats + nuts on training nights only — skip on rest days.
No added sugar in banana/chikku shakes. Fruit + milk stay.
1 paratha not 2; rice ~1 cup not 1.5. Protein and veg stay full.

cook_rules: Kam tel — less oil, don't deep-fry
Tawa ya grill — not deep fried
Shake mein cheeni nahi — no added sugar
